samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: In the context of online university classes, courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion. What problems can this create, and how could they be reduced?
requirementsVi: Phân tích tác hại, không thay bằng chỉ kể nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp tương ứng.
Giải thích cách đánh giá giải pháp có ích.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The fact that courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion can create difficulties in the context of online university classes. A useful idea may fail to help the people it is intended for. It is therefore important to examine the practical problems and suggest changes that deal with them directly.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu tình trạng và yêu cầu bàn tác hại.

paragraphs.label: Vấn đề và ảnh hưởng
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some learners may feel isolated. This matters because a screen does not always make it easy to ask a quick question or form friendships. For instance, a first-year student may stop working on a difficult task instead of asking a classmate for help. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu tác hại với người cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giá trị bị bỏ lỡ
paragraphs.text: Another concern is that the potential benefit may not be realised. The original aim is useful because students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. When the arrangement does not work, people may lose this opportunity as well as the time they have already spent trying to participate. This can make them less willing to try again.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phát triển hệ quả: mất cơ hội và sự tin tưởng.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to schedule small weekly discussion groups. For example, a teacher could meet six students at a time and ask each person to explain one difficult point. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cách làm trực tiếp giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the main problems include the possibility that some learners may feel isolated and that a useful opportunity is lost. A response based on practical needs, such as the decision to schedule small weekly discussion groups, is more likely to help than simply repeating that the original idea is worthwhile.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt vấn đề và giải pháp, không mở ý mới.

samples.title: Học suốt đời
samples.focus: learning new skills as an adult
samples.prompt: In the context of learning new skills as an adult, course providers may focus on fees while overlooking practical access. What problems can this create, and how could they be reduced?
requirementsVi: Phân tích tác hại, không thay bằng chỉ kể nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp tương ứng.
Giải thích cách đánh giá giải pháp có ích.
samples.summaryVi: Lớp học cho người lớn cần vừa túi tiền và phù hợp giờ làm, đi lại, chăm con.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The fact that course providers may focus on fees while overlooking practical access can create difficulties in the context of learning new skills as an adult. A useful idea may fail to help the people it is intended for. It is therefore important to examine the practical problems and suggest changes that deal with them directly.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu tình trạng và yêu cầu bàn tác hại.

paragraphs.label: Vấn đề và ảnh hưởng
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. This matters because transport, childcare and changing work hours can create barriers. For instance, a parent may miss an evening class because there is no one available to look after a child. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu tác hại với người cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giá trị bị bỏ lỡ
paragraphs.text: Another concern is that the potential benefit may not be realised. The original aim is useful because adults can update skills without returning to full-time study. For example, a shop assistant can attend an evening computer class to learn how to manage simple spreadsheets. When the arrangement does not work, people may lose this opportunity as well as the time they have already spent trying to participate. This can make them less willing to try again.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phát triển hệ quả: mất cơ hội và sự tin tưởng.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to offer flexible schedules and simple support for attendance. For example, a centre could repeat the same lesson at two different times and provide materials for missed sessions. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cách làm trực tiếp giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the main problems include the possibility that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend and that a useful opportunity is lost. A response based on practical needs, such as the decision to offer flexible schedules and simple support for attendance, is more likely to help than simply repeating that the original idea is worthwhile.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt vấn đề và giải pháp, không mở ý mới.
